about_the_game:
A Love Without Limits is a slice-of-life adult visual novel. You step into the role of a married man striving to keep the spark alive in his relationship while building a future and starting a family. Together with your wife, you explore new dimensions of intimacy and connection. But as life unfolds, unexpected challenges emerge—testing your loyalty, your desires, and the strength of your bond.

This story is played exclusively from the main character(MC) perspective. He (and the player) only know what he has seen, been told, or been shown, so some events will happen of which he is unaware. Decisions made will influence these unknown events.

The main focus of the sexual part of the game is on swinging, and how and why the main couple go about this. The swinging parts of the game are not avoidable, though there are choices involved in who you swing with in most cases. There are other, avoidable sexual paths in the game as well. These include cheating, sharing (hotwife/hothusband) that will open up other scenarios. Exhibitionism, teasing, flirting, and other soft scenes are also shown.

Throughout the story, you guide the main character through fortunes, and misfortune, based on choices you make. Will you be a virtuous husband, or a lecherous one, as you and your wife embark on the world of the swinging lifestyle. Temptations are around every corner, and how you deal with these temptations will shape the story, your marriage, and your life.

Every decision shapes the narrative and influences how others respond to you, especially your wife. Choose wisely, because your actions carry weight.The choices you make will not only affect you, but also those around you. And there are consequences for the decisions you make. Many of these can and will have long-lasting repercussions.

This is a choice-driven story, with multiple endings. Some choices will not have much influence on the overall story, while others will have a great impact. And while the choices are not defined as such, they should be obvious as to the likely outcome. There are no wrong choices, but each one will play a part in the overall outcome of the story.

There are paths, but they are not strictly defined in the game. The decisions made can lead you down one or multiple paths, with the possibility of having multiple paths opened at the same time, and changing each in different ways. The main character and his wife are the focus of the story. However, throughout your journey, you’ll encounter a variety of characters—from colleagues and neighbors to casual acquaintances—each bringing new temptations, tensions, or insights. Each with their own personality, and goals. How you relate to them can change their feelings and actions towards you. Some of these side characters are small in scope, while others play major parts.

content_descriptors.notes:
This is an adult visual novel intended for mature audiences. It contains explicit, consensual sexual activity between the main character, his wife, and other acquaintances. Sexual acts include oral sex and vaginal sex.

The game also includes a few depictions of war, which some players may find sensitive.
